items.title: Buster Williams interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: one of my first gigs was with Jimmy Heath at one of these cabarets. Jimmy Heath was one band, and Sam Wied was the other band, all Philadelphia musicians.

ctx.x: Well not like that I guess.

Yeah, we used to have this big place in Philadelphia called the Seven Eleven. And it was a ballroom. And they’d have two bands, in fact one of my first gigs was with Jimmy Heath at one of these cabarets. Jimmy Heath was one band, and Sam Wied was the other band, all Philadelphia musicians. And your reservation — you’d have your own table and a big party of people come for your table. There was a big ballroom, and you bring your own liquor. And what they would serve you there at the ballroom would be ginger ale,…
I see. And that was called the set up.
